video_title: Melo Breaks Down the REAL Message Behind Jaylen Brown’s Warning to Jayson Tatum

quotes.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's comments on Jayson Tatum and the Celtics
quotes.excerpt: This is not a Shaq and Kobe situation, you know, there will never be beef.

text_blocks.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
text_blocks.text: Right after the Knicks played the Celtics and they won, Jayson Tatum was asked about these Jaylen Brown quotes. When Jayson Tatum went on IG, he said, 'Oh man, why would you trade him down the road?' Jaylen Brown hops in the IG comments, throws the cap, but when there, he's asked about it, Jayson Tatum immediately dismisses it. He says this is not a Shaq and Kobe situation, you know, there will never be beef.

text_blocks.speaker: The Kid Mero
text_blocks.text: Jaylen Brown kind of agrees, but he says this ain't no beef, it's more like lamb chops and gravy. He put on the cap.

quotes.speaker: Kazeem Famuyide
quotes.summary_phrase: Jaylen Brown's comments on Jayson Tatum's PR and management
quotes.excerpt: He said he has great PR and he has to watch his back.
quotes.quote: When they asked him after Jayson Tatum responded, he said something along the lines of, 'Jayson's a great human being, great family, great team.' He said he has great PR, which I thought was a comment, and he said something along the lines of, 'He has to watch his back.' I don't know if that was some, you know, watch how that organization treated you because they treated me crazy, or like, 'I'm a competitor and even though we don't got beef, I still want to take your head off.'

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony on the nature of the Celtics' internal dynamics
quotes.excerpt: It's no more of Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown. This is separated.
quotes.quote: Because I was around that situation, it tells me that this is what it is. It's no more of Jayson Tatum and Jaylen Brown. This is separated. This is you went on, I did our thing and two things could be right at the same time. Two things could be wrong at the same time. I think that's what we're dealing with here. Nobody is going to know other than Jayson Tatum on his side and Jaylen Brown on his side and the people who was around that scenario.

quotes.speaker: Carmelo Anthony
quotes.summary_phrase: Carmelo Anthony warns Jayson Tatum about his inner circle
quotes.excerpt: He's telling Jayson Tatum to watch your back because all the people that's around you watch that.
quotes.quote: He's telling Jayson Tatum to watch your back because all the people that's around you watch that. And I'm not saying your immediate people, I'm saying people that you may think that's in the business, that may have your best interest, that your support, they really don't. And they want this. So watch out for the people because you haven't dealt with that. I dealt with that. Me and Jaylen Brown, he had, he deal with that, but that's something you don't have to deal with. You were protected from that in a sense because of it was a different aura that they can point at that energy.

quotes.speaker: The Kid Mero
quotes.summary_phrase: The Kid Mero on the Celtics' leadership dynamic
quotes.excerpt: It seems like Jaylen Brown might have to poke the bear a little bit because it seems like Jayson Tatum knows how to run the company.
quotes.quote: I saw a pod with him with the fathers talking and I like that. I think it was with LaVar Ball. And I saw them talking and I was like, you know what, no matter what happened with the Suns, obviously these men came up together and the family part that they talked about, like, yo, you got a good family. I think it's all within the lines like you said. I think ultimately they're both professional, they're businessmen. I feel like Jaylen Brown might have to poke the bear a little bit because it seems like Jayson Tatum knows how to run the company line. More than likely the Celtics might have liked that a little bit more.
